data.name: The Forsaken Crown
data.detailed_description:
Awake. Fight. Die. Learn.

Step into an atmospheric, stylized low-poly world where every mistake could be your last. This hardcore action RPG combines the relentless gameplay of classic Soulslikes with a unique, angular art style.

Key Features:

  • Precise Combat System: Every strike costs stamina, and every dodge roll must be perfectly timed. No button-mashing – just pure, skill-based gameplay.

  • Unique Low-Poly Look: A minimalist yet dark aesthetic with a nostalgic retro flair, guaranteeing maximum performance and buttery-smooth 60+ FPS.

  • Epic Boss Battles: Face off against monumental guardians that will put your patience and tactics to the ultimate test.

  • Lost Secrets: Explore a cryptic world, discover powerful weapons, and adapt your playstyle to survive the oncoming darkness.

data.short_description: Master unforgiving combat in a minimalist world. This low-poly Soulslike challenges your reflexes with precise dodge rolls and brutal timing. Explore bleak landscapes with a charming retro flair and conquer monumental bosses.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 oder AMD Phenom II X4 965
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 oder AMD Radeon HD 6870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad/Controller dringend empfohlen.
